Proxy re-encryption

Source: R/methods-eval-backlog.R
re_key_gen.Rd

re_key_gen() makes a re-encryption key from one party's secret key and another party's public key. With it, re_encrypt() turns a ciphertext under the first party's key into one the second party can decrypt, without decrypting it. The context needs Feature$PRE.

Usage

re_key_gen(cc, old_private_key, new_public_key)

re_encrypt(ct, eval_key, public_key = NULL)

Arguments

cc

A CryptoContext.

old_private_key

The PrivateKey the ciphertexts are currently encrypted under.

new_public_key

The PublicKey of the party who is to decrypt.

ct

A Ciphertext.

eval_key

The EvalKey from re_key_gen().

public_key

The PublicKey of the party the ciphertext is currently encrypted for, or NULL (default). It is used to re-randomize the result in the security modes that require it.

Value

re_key_gen() returns an EvalKey; re_encrypt() a Ciphertext.
